description.value: Purple Grain is a health-focused café inside Vancouver General Hospital's Diamond Plaza Building, serving fresh salads, warm bowls, pho, smoothies, and hot rolls made from wholesome ingredients prepared daily. The globally inspired menu includes Salmon Poke Bowls, Masala Chickpea Buddha Bowls, Jamaican Patties, and an extensive catering program. It is open to the public and draws a mix of hospital staff, visitors, and neighbourhood regulars.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (24 spaces) at 44m; stands (5 spaces) at 51m; stands (5 spaces, covered) at 59m. Total: 34 spaces.
